Inspect fusion groups on a free gene tree

Source: R/free-fusion-groups.R
free_fusion_groups.Rd

Taxon restriction determines the primitive members that share each projected split. Every member has structural state NA_fuse. At the group coordinate, the free tree either displays the exact split or lacks it (NA_fuse_topo). Absence includes an unresolved tree that does not display the split.

Usage

free_fusion_groups(free)

Arguments

free

A splitaligner_result from align_branches() in free mode.

Value

A data frame with one row per gene and composite, including its primitive member IDs, projected split, numeric evidence and recovery status. graph_class is Mapped or NA_fuse_topo. The character final_token holds the recovered group length, literal "NA" when the displayed edge lacks a finite length, or "NA_fuse_topo" when the split is absent. Each composite is counted once, separately from its primitive members.

See also

pair_alignment_results()
